# Audio Transcription Studio

> Free offline desktop audio and video transcription app for macOS and Windows powered by Tauri 2, Rust, React, and whisper.cpp.

- Repository: https://github.com/voice-to-text/audio-transcription-service
- Docs: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/
- Watch Folder guide: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/watch-folder-automation.html
- Formats & Languages: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/offline-whisper-formats.html
- Architecture & Tests: https://voice-to-text.github.io/audio-transcription-service/architecture-and-testing.html
